entities.summary: Elisaveta Georgieva Konsulova-Vazova was one of the first women to become a professional artist in Bulgaria. She is credited with being the first Bulgarian woman to paint a nude figure at the State School of Painting and the first woman to host a solo exhibition in Bulgaria. With international study experience, she became a noted art critic, publishing articles focused on Bulgarian culture and women's participation in the arts.
